payload.public_summary: The blocking problem choices have been resolved. The specification is now scientifically executable for an autonomous derivation of the bulk optical absorption coefficient as a function of photon energy from ordinary DFT-accessible Kohn-Sham quantities in the independent-particle interband picture.

specification_sections.name: purpose
specification_sections.content: Derive the dependence of the bulk optical absorption coefficient on photon energy, starting from quantities obtainable from an ordinary DFT calculation.

specification_sections.name: scientific_target
specification_sections.content: A formal derivation of the 3D bulk absorption coefficient α(ħω) as a function of photon energy for a periodic solid, using ordinary DFT-accessible Kohn-Sham band energies, orbitals, and occupations within the independent-particle interband optical-response picture.

specification_sections.name: givens_and_starting_point
specification_sections.content: The derivation starts from ordinary DFT-accessible Kohn-Sham quantities: band energies E_n(k), Bloch orbitals |n,k>, and occupations f_n(k). These are sufficient to construct interband optical transition matrix elements and the independent-particle dielectric response.

specification_sections.name: notation_and_conventions
specification_sections.content: Use standard condensed-matter optical-response notation: photon energy ħω, band energies E_n(k), occupations f_n(k), and interband matrix elements written in a velocity or momentum form by default. The derivation proceeds through the imaginary part of the dielectric function before converting to α(ħω).

specification_sections.name: assumptions_and_regime
specification_sections.content: The target regime is a 3D bulk periodic solid treated in the Kohn-Sham independent-particle picture, with vertical interband optical transitions only. Intraband/Drude, excitonic, and phonon-assisted processes are excluded from the required derivation.

specification_sections.name: scope_and_non_goals
specification_sections.content: The required deliverable is a formal derivation, not an implementation workflow. The scope is limited to bulk interband absorption derivable from ordinary DFT-accessible Kohn-Sham electronic structure, excluding many-body and indirect-transition corrections.

specification_sections.name: required_output
specification_sections.content: A self-contained formal derivation from DFT-accessible Kohn-Sham quantities to the bulk absorption coefficient α(ħω), showing the chain from interband transition matrix elements to Im ε(ω) and then to the absorption coefficient as a function of photon energy.

specification_sections.name: validation_criteria
specification_sections.content: The final derivation must end at the bulk absorption coefficient α(ħω), must use only the resolved ordinary-DFT starting quantities, and must include only independent-particle interband optical physics for a 3D bulk solid.

specification_sections.name: agent_discretion
specification_sections.content: All remaining conventions and approximation-level choices are delegated to the derivation agent, which should begin from the simplest compatible baseline and refine only if needed for coherence.

declared_defaults.title: Unit system
declared_defaults.rationale: The unit system is interchangeable and does not change the target physics or deliverable.

declared_defaults.title: Optical matrix-element form
declared_defaults.statement: Default to the velocity or momentum-matrix-element route, translated as needed to equivalent dipole forms.
declared_defaults.rationale: Gauge or equivalent matrix-element form is translatable and does not affect the blocking scientific specification.

declared_defaults.title: Line shape
declared_defaults.statement: Default to an ideal delta-function spectrum at the baseline rung.
declared_defaults.rationale: Line-shape convention does not change the included physics and can be refined later without changing the problem statement.

declared_defaults.title: Response conversion route
declared_defaults.statement: Default to deriving Im ε(ω) first and then converting to the absorption coefficient.
declared_defaults.rationale: The route through equivalent response quantities is conventional and does not alter the scientific target.

declared_defaults.title: Real dielectric part
declared_defaults.statement: Default to obtaining the real part from the imaginary part by the standard dispersive relation when needed.
declared_defaults.rationale: This is a standard interchangeable convention and not a blocking scientific choice.
alternatives: direct independent expression for Re ε

declared_defaults.title: Electronic-structure level
declared_defaults.statement: Default to general Kohn-Sham Bloch bands rather than reducing to an effective two-band model.
declared_defaults.rationale: The resolved starting point is ordinary DFT-accessible Kohn-Sham electronic structure, so the baseline should stay at that level.

declared_defaults.title: Matrix-element complexity
declared_defaults.statement: Default to k-dependent interband transition matrix elements.
declared_defaults.rationale: State-dependent matrix elements are naturally available from the resolved Kohn-Sham starting point and are the most direct baseline for the requested derivation.

declared_defaults.title: Spectral broadening level
declared_defaults.statement: Default baseline uses an ideal delta function, with finite broadening deferred to a higher refinement rung.
declared_defaults.rationale: Broadening level is an approximation refinement, not a blocking problem choice.

refinement_ladder.name: Textbook Independent-Particle Baseline
refinement_ladder.relaxes: Nothing below it; this is the simplest baseline compatible with the resolved problem constraints.

refinement_ladder.name: Resolved Target Derivation
refinement_ladder.relaxes: Fixes the final deliverable, permitted DFT starting quantities, included optical physics, and bulk optical observable relative to rung 0.
